summary: Full backend + frontend pass for the NEW badges + celebration feature. Backend: 46/46 pass (10 brand-new badge tests in test_badges.py + 36 existing). Verified: (1) GET /api/badges returns 10 badges with correct shape (id/title/emoji/description/type/threshold/unlocked/current/progress) and Léa (lea@demo.fr) has exactly the 6 expected unlocks {first_quest, getting_started, task_machine, streak_3, earn_100, earn_500}; (2) fresh child registered in a brand-new family gets 'first_quest' back in new_badges of POST /api/tasks/{id}/complete on their first non-photo completion, and tasks_completed/total_earned/points all increment by the task's points_worth; (3) photo task completion returns status='pending' and new_badges=[] (empty) so no premature unlock; (4) vote-approval path: fresh parent approves a fresh child's pending photo submission → child's stats increment AND badge (first_quest) unlocks and is persisted, visible on next GET /api/badges; (5) full regression (demo logins, tasks, delete-account, leaderboard, rewards, calendar, shopping, penalties, push) still green. Frontend: 1 CRITICAL navigation bug fixed by testing agent (see rca_of_issue) — the auth gate was redirecting kids and parents away from every /shared/* route so /shared/badges, /shared/calendar, /shared/shopping, /shared/validate were unreachable via any tap. After a 1-line fix in app/_layout.tsx, all badge UI works: Kid Accueil shows 'Mes badges' section with 'Voir tout (6/10)' + 4 preview tiles, tapping opens /shared/badges with 10-tile grid (6 unlocked/gold with 'Débloqué' pill, 4 locked with 🔒 + progress bar + current/threshold like 27/50, 1/7, 1/30, 27/1000), 'Mes badges' link in Plus tab works. Task completion on Tâches tab shows '🎉 Bravo ! +10 points' flash that auto-clears after 3s, no runtime error (expo-audio call succeeds — audio itself not audible in headless webkit).

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx AuthedGate contained `if (user.role === 'child' && !inKid) router.replace('/(kid)')` (and the parent equivalent) — so any authenticated user whose current top segment was 'shared' (or anything else) was immediately bounced to their tab-group home. This made every Pressable that called router.push('/shared/…') look like it did nothing. REPRODUCTION: log in as lea@demo.fr, tap 'Voir tout (6/10)' or Plus > 'Mes badges' → URL flashes to /shared/badges then reverts to /. Also reproducible by pasting /shared/badges in the address bar (with a valid session): app redirects to /. MITIGATION: added `const inShared = segments[0] === 'shared'` and changed the outer condition to `else if (user && !inShared)` so /shared/* routes bypass the role redirect. Verified: after fix, tap → URL becomes /shared/badges and 10 tiles render (6 gold + 4 locked with progress). No regression on login-redirect: unauthenticated /shared/badges still bounces to /(auth)/login (that branch is unchanged).
